svg.text: Storage map: every file and folder read or written — checked against src/ (2026-11-13)
Blue = written/enforced by agent-room harness · Amber = written by agents under role instructions · Grey = external CLI state
1. Room root: <root>/ (--cwd)
<root>/* (project files & root docs)
• Read by discussion agents, worker, and docs.mjs (confined to realpath)
• User merges worker branches into <root> manually (git merge)
discussions/<date-title>/ (created by ui.mjs on 1st message)
• transcripts/session-YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM[-n].md
Written by ui.mjs (createSessionFile, log): every round, summary & report
• files/<name>: attachments saved by ui.mjs (≤25 MB each, ≤250 MB/msg)
Written inside discussions/<date-title>/ by agents (role instructions):
• notes.md, drawings/*.svg: discussion notes, diagrams & worker plans
• handoff.md → renamed to handoff-read-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.md
• pending-instructions.md: unsent worker instructions word for word
discussions/archive/ & discussions/deferred/
• Whole discussion folder moved by ui.mjs (/move, Archive, Defer, Resume)
Note: a Brainstorm has no folder, transcript or files here (lives in RAM only).
Agent-room checkout also holds README-for-*-agents.md, read on load/Reload.
2. Worker Git worktrees & repository metadata
Sibling worktree folders (created by ui.mjs on 1st worker task)
• <repo>.workers/<name>/ on branch worker/<name> (one per discussion)
• <repo>.worker/ on branch worker/main (brainstorm, pre-title, or legacy)
Fast-forwarded to main before a task by ui.mjs when clean & strictly behind.
Written inside the worktree by the Worker (worker rulebook):
• Tracked project edits, committed on worker/<name> with [<origin>] prefix
• .worker-notes/<task>/: temporary scratch notes (deleted on stage accepted)
Private Git metadata (inside <root>/.git/, never committed)
• <worktree-git-dir>/agent-room-task.json (ownerFile() in ui.mjs):
Written before task starts ({ version, root, label, task, before }); removed
when worktree is clean. Identifies who holds the lane if uncommitted edits remain.
• <main-git-dir>/info/exclude:
ui.mjs appends .worker-notes/ so worker scratch files stay untracked.
• git merge-tree --write-tree (Git ≥ 2.38) writes unreferenced preview objects
during Worker tab status checks (cleaned up by Git's own git gc).
3. Local machine state (~/.config, ~/.local — never replicated)
~/.config/agent-room/defaults.json (ui.mjs)
Saved provider, agent name & model defaults across folders and launches.
~/.local/state/agent-room/paused/<sha256(root)>/<sha256(name)>.json
Per-discussion checkpoint (ui.mjs): session IDs, chat, seen map, worker log &
tasks, token totals; or fresh: true holding only the previous session's summary.
~/.local/state/agent-room/programs/<pid>.json (agents.mjs)
One file per running CLI process group; scanned by findLeftovers() after crash/Restart.
~/.local/share/agent-room/notes/<sha256(root)>/<id>.md (notes.mjs)
User's Notes pane files (loopback only); never in <root>, unseen by agents.
External CLI & launcher files on this machine:
• ~/.codex/models_cache.json (or $CODEX_HOME): read by ui.mjs for model dropdown
• Provider session stores (e.g. ~/.claude/projects/, Codex & agy state): owned by CLIs
• ~/Library/Logs/agent-room.log: written by the macOS Dock launcher script
4. Replication store: <root>/.agent-room/ (optional, --node)
Managed by src/replicate.mjs (launch room only; separate from project Git):
store.git/ (bare Git repository)
• refs/lines/<discId>/<node>: local round commits (files + .agent-room-round.json)
• refs/received/<discId>/<node> & refs/incoming/…: verified peer bundles
Metadata & staging files in <root>/.agent-room/
• room.json: established room ID, this node's name, paired peers
• discussions.json: maps local discussion folder names to discussion IDs
• acked.json: latest commit SHA acknowledged by each peer
• tmp/: temporary bundles and atomic-write staging files
received/<discId>/<node>/ (read-only peer views)
• snapshots/<commit>/: unpacked peer discussion files (mode 0444)
• published.json: atomic pointer to latest snapshot; leased snapshots
stay while viewed in a browser (2-min lease), older unleased ones are pruned.
All agent-room JSON state updates use write-aside (.tmp) + atomic rename. Agents have full filesystem access; folder boundaries are instructions.
